Missing item: Paid Render PostgreSQL with daily backups (render.yaml names no plan)
Why it matters: All accounts and payments live in one database
Risk if missing: Free Postgres has no backups and expires; total data loss
Solution: Choose a paid Postgres plan in the Render dashboard; turn on backups; test one restore
Acceptance: Backup visible in Render; a restore to a scratch DB works

Missing item: Production health check after deploy
Solution: Open https://app.propelo.org/api/ready; sign up with a real address; run docs/launch.md checks
Acceptance: ready returns ok; verify email arrives; dashboard loads

Missing item: Real SMTP (SMTP_URL; MAIL_FROM on propelo.org with SPF/DKIM/DMARC)
Why it matters: Sign-up cannot finish without the confirm email
Risk if missing: No one can create an account
Solution: Set SMTP_URL and MAIL_FROM on Render; add SPF/DKIM/DMARC records
Acceptance: Confirm and reset emails arrive in Gmail inbox (not spam)

Missing item: propelo.org on GitHub Pages and app.propelo.org on Render; SITE_URL repository variable
Why it matters: Links in emails and the site point at the domain
Solution: Add the CNAME records; set Pages custom domain; set vars.SITE_URL and PUBLIC_URL
Acceptance: https://propelo.org and https://app.propelo.org load with valid certificates

Missing item: Razorpay live keys and webhook (and Dodo for USD)
Solution: Set RAZORPAY_* live values; add webhook URL /api/billing/webhook with the secret; buy Pro with a real card and refund
Acceptance: Plan turns on after a real payment; refund recorded

Missing item: Two-step sign-in on the admin account
Why it matters: Admin can grant plans and suspend accounts; staff APIs refuse admins without it in production
Risk if missing: Admin locked out of staff tools; account takeover risk
Solution: Sign in as admin; Settings > Account > Two-step sign-in; store recovery codes offline

Missing item: SECRETS_KEY set and kept (render.yaml generates one)
Why it matters: Encrypts stored keys and two-step secrets
Risk if missing: Rotating it loses stored AI keys and two-step setups
Solution: Confirm SECRETS_KEY exists; copy to a password manager

Missing item: Two-step sign-in (TOTP + recovery codes)
Why it matters: Staff and admin accounts are high value
Solution: Built in 2.9.0; required for staff/admin in production

Missing item: Admin console UI (accounts; grant; staff; suspend; audit log)
Solution: Built /admin in 2.9.0

Missing item: Suspend an account
Solution: POST /api/admin/disable ends sessions and keys

Missing item: Scan hung for 2+ hours and was cancelled
Why it matters: Feed went stale for many hours
Solution: Deadline with carry-over of late boards' previous roles (CAREEROS_SCAN_DEADLINE_MIN=60)
Acceptance: test_scan_deadline_keeps_late_boards_roles passes; next CI scan finishes under the job limit

Missing item: Copy said roles refresh hourly; real cadence is about every 5-9 hours
Solution: Changed to 'several times a day' everywhere
Acceptance: grep finds no hourly claim in site or app

Missing item: gitleaks failed on public board slugs
Solution: Allowlist feed/boards files; full history scan

Missing item: Unknown pages returned JSON
Solution: Branded 404 page for page paths

Missing item: Staff/admin pages returned 401 JSON when signed out
Solution: Redirect to /login?next=

Missing item: No robots.txt; sitemap.xml or canonical on site and app
Why it matters: Search engines index private or duplicate pages
Solution: Generated robots/sitemap/canonical/Open Graph/JSON-LD; noindex on private pages

Missing item: Legal pages shared one title and description
Solution: Distinct titles/descriptions/canonicals

Missing item: Tab roles and contrast issues (axe)
Solution: Fixed tab roles; darker good colour; decorative numerals moved to CSS
Acceptance: axe: 0 violations on all audited pages (22 Nov)

Missing item: Pricing page had no H1
Solution: Added H1

Missing item: No in-app way to ask for help
Solution: Add a Help link in the dashboard that opens a prefilled email to SUPPORT_EMAIL; later a ticket form
Acceptance: Help link visible on every tab

Missing item: Job roles not indexable one by one (hash routes); no JobPosting structured data
Why it matters: Job pages are the biggest organic channel
Solution: Generate static pages for a capped set of roles with JobPosting JSON-LD (only when the posting is still open)
Acceptance: Google Rich Results test passes on a sample

Missing item: No product analytics (sign-up funnel; activation)
Solution: Add privacy-friendly server-side event counts (signup; verified; first resume; first match; first apply; checkout) to /admin

Missing item: No blog; guides; about page or case studies
Solution: Write an About page first (who runs it and why); guides later; never invent testimonials

Missing item: Google Fonts loaded from Google
Why it matters: GDPR: IP sent to Google without consent
Solution: Self-host the font files

Missing item: Uploads stored on a single 1 GB Render disk
Why it matters: Resumes are kept on the web service's disk
Solution: Move blobs to object storage (S3/R2) when more than one web instance is needed
Acceptance: Two instances can serve the same file

Missing item: Status page
Why it matters: Members need to know if it is down
Solution: Free status page (e.g. UptimeRobot) on /api/health

Missing item: Firefox and Safari not tested
Solution: Run the J1 and J2 journeys in Safari (iOS and macOS) and Firefox

Missing item: Mobile app builds not built or tested
Solution: Build Android debug APK and test sign-in and the queue

Missing item: Chrome extension in a real profile
Solution: Load unpacked extension; autofill one Greenhouse and one Lever form; confirm it never submits

Missing item: Dashboard logs console 404s for empty documents
Solution: Return 204/empty JSON for missing optional documents
Acceptance: No console errors on an empty account

Missing item: No guided first-run tour
Solution: Short checklist already exists; add progress to it and an email when first matches arrive

Missing item: No list of signed-in devices
Solution: List sessions with device and last seen; end one

Missing item: Rate limits on verify/reset/join roll back with a failed attempt
Solution: Record the hit in a separate transaction as done for login and two-step
Acceptance: Test shows 429 after N bad tokens

Missing item: Production security headers and cookies not seen live
Solution: curl -I https://app.propelo.org and check HSTS; CSP; cookie Secure

Missing item: Error monitoring (SENTRY_DSN) not set
Solution: Set SENTRY_DSN on web and worker

Missing item: GST invoices and receipts
Why it matters: Indian B2B buyers need GST invoices
Solution: Register for GST when required; use Razorpay invoices for business plans
Acceptance: Invoice with GSTIN sent for a test purchase

Missing item: Feed freshness depends on GitHub Actions minutes and runner time
Why it matters: Free minutes are limited for private repos
Solution: Repo is public (unlimited minutes); keep it public or budget minutes

Missing item: Product docs kept in sync with code
Solution: scripts/product_docs.py --check in the test suite

Missing item: DPDP Act (India) and GDPR: data export and deletion
Solution: Export and delete exist in Settings; add a named grievance officer and contact to Privacy

Missing item: Job Guarantee (8% fee after joining) and Interview Guarantee terms reviewed by a lawyer
Solution: Have terms; refunds and privacy reviewed before charging for guarantees; until then keep guarantees invite-only

Missing item: Business terms (consultancy data processing)
Solution: Short data processing terms in /terms business section reviewed

Missing item: No paying customers yet
Solution: Run the free pilots with 3-5 consultancies; convert at Starter (₹14999)

Missing item: Backups of uploads disk
Why it matters: Resumes on the disk are not in database backups
Solution: Render disk snapshots are automatic on paid plans; confirm; or move to object storage (R-025)

Missing item: Dashboard SPA keeps hidden views with extra H1s in jobs.html
Solution: Use one H1 per visible view

Missing item: Feed intake held the whole feed in memory (about 3.2 GB for 95k roles) and downloaded it every 15 minutes
Why it matters: A small Render worker has 512 MB to 2 GB
Risk if missing: Intake killed for memory; no new matches for anyone
Solution: Intake now checks the summary first; streams the files from disk; writes only roles that changed (2.10.0)
Acceptance: Local run on the live feed: peak about 100 MB; unchanged feed writes 0 rows; owner checks the worker log shows 'ingested'

Missing item: US H-1B sponsor history per employer
Why it matters: The largest group of Indian students abroad is in the US
Risk if missing: Weaker than Jobright for US roles
Dependency: USCIS H-1B Employer Data Hub (reported offline since March 2026)
Solution: Until the data is back: read OPT; CPT; E-Verify and citizens-only lines from postings (done in 2.10.0); add the employer history when USCIS republishes files

Missing item: Sponsor lists for Canada; Ireland; Germany; Australia
Why it matters: Students there get only what the posting says
Risk if missing: Less useful outside UK; NL and US
Dependency: Public data per country (Canada LMIA employers list; Ireland permit statistics)
Solution: Add one register at a time with the same matching as the UK and Dutch ones
Acceptance: Roles in each country show a register line

Missing item: Scan ran about 4 times a day because GitHub delays scheduled runs
Solution: Each scan starts the next (2.10.0); boards rotate so a run fits its time as the list grows
Acceptance: GitHub shows scans back to back; summary.json generatedAt under 90 minutes old

Missing item: Database size as the feed grows (role text is stored for every role)
Why it matters: Render Postgres plans have storage limits
Solution: Watch size in Render; keep FEED_MAX at 120000 until the plan allows more
